mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that triggers a shift toward tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative outlook for corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect (e.g., product of the two series) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5 and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS in the high unemployment regime is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates a contraction in the real economy, which reduces corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.5% in a 3-month window, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS in the low unemployment regime is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units, it indicates a strengthening in the housing sector and consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
